title: Flat for rent
text:
FLAT FOR RENT – Kraków, Podgórze

A sunny two-room flat on the third floor of a new building (2019). There is a lift.

The flat has got a living room with a kitchen, one bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a small balcony. It is 42 square metres. The flat is furnished: there is a sofa, a bed, a wardrobe, a table and four chairs. The kitchen has got a fridge, a cooker and a dishwasher. There is no washing machine, but there is a laundry in the basement.

The flat is five minutes from a tram stop and ten minutes from the river. There are shops and a park nearby.

Rent: 2,800 zł a month + bills (about 400 zł).
Deposit: one month's rent.
No pets. No smoking.
Available from 1 October.

Please write to Marta: marta.flat@mail.pl
